repos.description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 82 skills, 15 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.
repos.intro: A self-contained Claude skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work · 83 skills · 15 slash commands · 681 disclosed-report patterns (433 now individually cited & auditable) across 24 core vulnerability classes · enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices · engagement-folder scaffolding · Burp MCP…
features: No hypothesis discipline — drafts written before validation → wasted hours, hurt validity ratio
No per-program reporting tactics — VRT defaults auto-downgraded P3-worthy findings to P4
No engagement coordination — findings, evidence, and submission IDs scattered across folders
No evidence hygiene — screenshots leaked cookies and victim PII
repos.description_zh: 一個用於漏洞獵殺與外部紅隊作業的 Claude Code skill bundle — 包含 82 個 skills、15 個 slash commands、涵蓋 24 個核心漏洞類別的 681 個已公開報告模式，以及企業身分 + 基礎設施攻擊矩陣。
repos.intro_zh: 一個用於漏洞獵殺與外部紅隊作業的獨立 Claude skill bundle · 83 個 skills · 15 個 slash commands · 涵蓋 24 個核心漏洞類別的 681 個已公開報告模式（其中 433 個現在可個別引用與稽核） · 企業身分 + 基礎設施攻擊矩陣 · engagement-folder scaffolding · Burp MCP…
features_zh: 缺乏假設紀律 — 在驗證前就撰寫草稿 → 浪費數小時，損害有效率比
缺乏針對個別程式的報告策略 — VRT 預設會將具備 P3 價值的發現自動降級為 P4
缺乏專案協調 — 發現、證據與提交 ID 散落在各個資料夾中
缺乏證據衛生管理 — 螢幕截圖洩漏了 cookies 與受害者的 PII
repos.description_src: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 82 skills, 15 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.

repos.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
repos.intro: An AI agent-led search engine scored by upvotes, likes, and real money - not editors.
features: Patent Secret Signals: a company run reads that month's US patent filings, with no key, and flags only the ones that are out of character or…
Jobs Page Secret Signals: it reads the company's own careers page and flags the roles that give away what's coming, including new teams nobo…
Quote lines: the best Reddit, X, YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram comments sit on their own line under the story they back up, translated when…
Polymarket odds line: one line under the story it bears on, with how much the odds moved.
Yahoo Finance line: a listed company's share price over the last 30 days next to the S&P 500, plus its biggest single-day move.
Knows who you mean: "Apple" resolves to the company, its site, and its ticker on its own.
repos.description_zh: AI agent 技能，可跨 Reddit、X、YouTube、HN、Polymarket 及網路研究任何主題，接著合成一份有根據的摘要
repos.intro_zh: 由 AI agent 主導的搜尋引擎，其評分標準為 upvotes、likes 與真金白銀，而非編輯。
features_zh: Patent Secret Signals：一家公司運行的程式會閱讀當月美國專利申請案，在沒有金鑰的情況下，僅標記出不符合其特徵或……的申請案
Jobs Page Secret Signals：它會閱讀公司自身的職缺頁面，並標記出會洩漏未來動向的職位，包括新成立的團隊等……
Quote lines：最精華的 Reddit、X、YouTube、TikTok 與 Instagram 留言會單獨列在它們所支持的故事下方的一行，並在需要時進行翻譯……
Polymarket odds line：在它所關聯的故事下方顯示一行，並標註賠率的變動幅度。
Yahoo Finance line：上市公司的股價在過去 30 天內的走勢（與 S&P 500 並列），外加其單日最大漲跌幅。
辨識你的意圖：輸入「Apple」會自動解析為該公司、其網站及其股票代碼。
repos.description_src: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary

repos.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
repos.intro: Open Code Review is an AI-powered code review CLI tool. It originated as Alibaba Group's internal official AI code review assistant — over the past two years, it has served tens of thousands of developers and identified millions of code defects.
features: Incomplete coverage — On larger changesets, agents tend to "cut corners," selectively reviewing only some files and missing others.
Position drift — Reported issues frequently don't match the actual code location, with line numbers or file references drifting off target.
Unstable quality — Natural-language-driven Skills are hard to debug, and review quality fluctuates significantly with minor prompt variation…
repos.description_zh: 安全、快速、高效，並在 Alibaba 的規模下經過實戰測試。混合架構程式碼審查工具：確定性 pipeline + LLM Agent，精確的行級評論，內建多語言規則集（NPE、thread-safety、XSS、SQL injection），相容 OpenAI 與 Anthropic。
repos.intro_zh: Open Code Review 是一款由 AI 驅動的程式碼審查 CLI 工具。它起源於 Alibaba Group 的內部官方 AI 程式碼審查助手 —— 在過去兩年中，它已為數萬名開發者提供服務，並識別出數百萬個程式碼缺陷。
features_zh: 覆蓋率不完整 —— 在較大的 changeset 上，agent 往往會「偷工減料」，選擇性地僅審查部分檔案而遺漏其他檔案。
位置偏移 —— 回報的問題經常與實際程式碼位置不符，行號或檔案引用會發生偏移。
品質不穩定 —— 由自然語言驅動的 Skills 難以除錯，且審查品質會隨著微小的 prompt 變化而大幅波動……
repos.description_src: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.

repos.description: Self-hosted workflows for coding-agent delivery. Orchestrate CodeBuddy, Codex and Claude Code with scripts and human approval gates. Includes Local workflows for coding assistants.
repos.intro: LoopForge is a self-hosted workspace where your team ships software with coding agents. Describe what you need to Main Bot in chat: it opens a Docker sandbox, checks out your repositories, delegates to project roles, and opens the PR.
features: Repeatable. Same SOP, same stages, same checks for every requirement. Start from built-in backend, frontend, bug-fix and product SOPs.
Separated roles. Planning, implementation, review and testing each get their own prompt, executor, model, rules, Skills and MCP tools.
Human in the loop. Approval gates where they matter. Read the report, approve, or send the work back to a chosen step.
Observable and resumable. Node status, tool traces, logs and artifacts in one place. Pause, retry a failed step, or rerun from any node.
Your stack, your servers. Ten coding-agent CLIs as executors, from CodeBuddy, Codex and Claude Code to OpenCode, Cursor CLI and more.
repos.description_zh: 用於 coding-agent 交付的 self-hosted 工作流。透過腳本與人工審核閘門（approval gates）來編排 CodeBuddy、Codex 與 Claude Code。包含用於 coding assistants 的 Local 工作流。
repos.intro_zh: LoopForge 是一個 self-hosted 工作空間，讓您的團隊能透過 coding agents 交付軟體。在聊天中向 Main Bot 描述您的需求：它會開啟一個 Docker sandbox、checkout 您的 repositories、委派給專案角色，並開啟 PR。
features_zh: 可重複性。針對每個需求都使用相同的 SOP、相同的階段與相同的檢查。可從內建的 backend、frontend、bug-fix 與 product SOPs 開始。
角色分離。規劃（Planning）、實作（implementation）、審查（review）與測試（testing）各別擁有各自的 prompt、executor、model、rules、Skills 與 MCP tools。
人機協作（Human in the loop）。在關鍵環節設置審核閘門。閱讀報告、核准，或將工作退回至指定的步驟。
可觀測且可續傳。在同一個地方查看 Node 狀態、tool traces、logs 與 artifacts。可以暫停、重試失敗的步驟，或從任何 node 重新執行。
您的技術棧，您的伺服器。提供十種 coding-agent CLIs 作為 executors，從 CodeBuddy、Codex 與 Claude Code 到 OpenCode、Cursor CLI 等。
repos.description_src: Self-hosted workflows for coding-agent delivery. Orchestrate CodeBuddy, Codex and Claude Code with scripts and human approval gates. Includes Local workflows for coding assistants.

repos.description: Build your own AI office with Univer Office SDK. Bring editing, calculation, collaboration, and file processing into your product for people and AI agents. Built on an extensible open-source core.
repos.intro: Start with open-source Sheets and Docs, then connect your own application or agent.
features: Between plugins: DependentOn declares runtime plugin dependencies. The plugin service orders them, and lifecycle stages separate dependency…
Inside plugins: dependency injection connects controllers and services through declared dependencies.
repos.description_zh: 使用 Univer Office SDK 打造您專屬的 AI 辦公室。為使用者與 AI agents 將編輯、計算、協作及檔案處理功能引入您的產品中。基於可擴展的開源核心所建構。
repos.intro_zh: 從開源的 Sheets 與 Docs 開始，接著連接您自己的應用程式或 agent。
features_zh: 在插件之間：DependentOn 用於宣告執行時期的插件依賴關係。插件服務會對其進行排序，且生命週期階段會將依賴關係進行區隔……
在插件內部：依賴注入（dependency injection）透過宣告的依賴關係來連接 controllers 與 services。
repos.description_src: Build your own AI office with Univer Office SDK. Bring editing, calculation, collaboration, and file processing into your product for people and AI agents. Built on an extensible open-source core.

repos.description: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.
repos.intro: AG-UI is an open, lightweight, event-based protocol that standardizes how AI agents connect to user-facing applications. Built for simplicity and flexibility, it enables seamless integration between AI agents, real time user context, and user interfaces.
features: 💬 Real-time agentic chat with streaming
🔄 Bi-directional state synchronization
🧩 Generative UI and structured messages
🧠 Real-time context enrichment
🛠️ Frontend tool integration
🧑‍💻 Human-in-the-loop collaboration
repos.description_zh: AG-UI：Agent-User Interaction Protocol。將 Agents 引入 Frontend Applications。
repos.intro_zh: AG-UI 是一個開放、輕量化且基於事件的 protocol，標準化了 AI agents 連接至 user-facing applications 的方式。其設計旨在追求簡單與靈活性，實現 AI agents、即時 user context 與 user interfaces 之間的無縫整合。
features_zh: 💬 具備 streaming 功能的即時 agentic chat
🔄 雙向狀態同步 (Bi-directional state synchronization)
🧩 Generative UI 與結構化訊息 (structured messages)
🧠 即時 context enrichment
🛠️ Frontend tool integration
🧑‍💻 Human-in-the-loop 協作
repos.description_src: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.

repos.description: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.
repos.intro: Everything you need to annotate and stay in the loop with your agents Inbox Surface • Artifacts • Code Review Annotate plans, specs, markdown, HTML, and other interactive artifacts. Review diffs and PRs. Send feedback to your agent.
features: URL annotation fetches the requested site, through Jina Reader by default for public pages or directly when Jina is disabled or unavailable.
GitHub and GitLab review uses your authenticated CLI and Git remote to retrieve PR or MR data.
Ask AI and review agents send the selected question and relevant plan, document, repository, or diff context to your configured provider.
Sharing sends the complete link to whoever or whatever service you use to deliver it.
Workspaces is a separate hosted product, so the open source app's local-storage model does not apply to content placed there.
repos.description_zh: 讓您能掌握 Agent 動態並參與其中的工作空間 —— 進行塑造、決策、規劃、註解、審查程式碼、與團隊分享，並能一鍵將所有回饋傳送給 Agent。
repos.intro_zh: 您進行註解並與 Agent 保持同步所需的一切。收件匣介面 • Artifacts • Code Review。註解計畫、規格、markdown、HTML 以及其他互動式 Artifacts。審查 diffs 與 PRs。將回饋傳送給您的 Agent。
features_zh: URL 註解預設會透過 Jina Reader 抓取公開網頁的請求內容，若停用或無法使用 Jina 時，則會直接抓取。
GitHub 與 GitLab 審查會使用您已驗證的 CLI 與 Git remote 來取得 PR 或 MR 資料。
Ask AI 與審查 Agent 會將選定的問題以及相關的計畫、文件、repository 或 diff context 傳送至您配置的 provider。
分享功能會將完整的連結傳送給您用來交付的對象或服務。
Workspaces 是一個獨立的託管產品，因此開源應用程式的 local-storage 模型並不適用於存放於該處的內容。
repos.description_src: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.

repos.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
repos.intro: Official sources only. Install ECC only from verified channels: the GitHub repository github.com/affaan-m/ECC , the npm packages ecc-universal and ecc-agentshield , the GitHub App , the plugin slug ecc@ecc , and the project website ecc.tools .
features: AGENTS.md at root is the universal cross-tool file (read by Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and OpenCode; GitHub Copilot uses .github/copilot-in…
DRY adapter pattern lets Cursor reuse Claude Code's hook scripts without duplication
Skills format (SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter) works across Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and GitHub Copilot CLI
Codex's narrower native hook set is supplemented by AGENTS.md , optional model_instructions_file overrides, and sandbox permissions
repos.description_zh: Agent harness 效能優化系統。針對 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Cursor 及更多工具，提供技能、直覺、記憶、安全性與研究優先的開發模式。
repos.intro_zh: 僅限官方來源。請僅透過已驗證的管道安裝 ECC：GitHub repository github.com/affaan-m/ECC 、npm packages ecc-universal 與 ecc-agentshield 、GitHub App、plugin slug ecc@ecc 以及專案網站 ecc.tools 。
features_zh: 根目錄下的 AGENTS.md 是通用的跨工具檔案（可由 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 與 OpenCode 讀取；GitHub Copilot 使用 .github/copilot-in…
DRY adapter pattern 讓 Cursor 能夠重複使用 Claude Code 的 hook scripts 而無需重複撰寫。
Skills 格式（帶有 YAML frontmatter 的 SKILL.md）可跨 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 與 GitHub Copilot CLI 使用。
Codex 較窄的 native hook set 可透過 AGENTS.md、選用的 model_instructions_file overrides 以及 sandbox permissions 進行補充。
repos.description_src: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.

repos.description: 🧠 Train a 64M-parameter LLM from scratch in just 2h!
repos.intro: 注：本项目基于 Apache 2.0 协议开源，完全免费。“2 小时” 指 SFT 阶段在单张 NVIDIA 3090 上跑完 1 epoch 的实测耗时，“3 块钱” 指对应时段的 GPU 租用成本。
features: 此开源项目旨在完全从 0 开始，仅用 3 块钱成本与 2 小时训练时间，即可训练出规模约为 64M 的超小语言模型 MiniMind。
MiniMind 系列极其轻量，主线最小版本体积约为 GPT-3 的 $\frac{1}{2700}$ ，力求让普通个人 GPU 也能快速完成训练与复现。
项目同时开源了大模型的极简结构与完整训练链路，覆盖 MoE、数据清洗、预训练（Pretrain）、监督微调（SFT）、LoRA、RLHF（DPO）、RLAIF（PPO / GRPO / CISPO）、Tool Use、Agentic RL、自适应思考与模型蒸馏等全过程代码。
MiniMind 同时拓展了视觉模态模型 MiniMind-V 、多模态 Omni 模型 MiniMind-O 、扩散语言模型（MiniMind-dLM）、线性模型（MiniMind-Linear），详见 Discussion 。
项目所有核心算法代码均从 0 使用 PyTorch 原生实现，不依赖第三方库提供的高层抽象接口。
这不仅是一个大语言模型全阶段开源复现项目，也是一套面向 LLM 入门与实践的教程。
repos.description_zh: 🧠 只需 2 小時，從零開始訓練一個 64M 參數的 LLM！
repos.intro_zh: 注意：本專案基於 Apache 2.0 協議開源，完全免費。「2 小時」是指 SFT 階段在單張 NVIDIA 3090 上跑完 1 epoch 的實測耗時，「3 塊錢」是指對應時段的 GPU 租用成本。
features_zh: 此開源專案旨在完全從 0 開始，僅用 3 塊錢成本與 2 小時訓練時間，即可訓練出規模約為 64M 的超小型語言模型 MiniMind。
MiniMind 系列極其輕量，主線最小版本體積約為 GPT-3 的 $\frac{1}{2700}$ ，力求讓一般個人 GPU 也能快速完成訓練與復現。
專案同時開源了大模型的極簡結構與完整訓練鏈路，涵蓋 MoE、數據清洗、Pretrain、SFT、LoRA、RLHF（DPO）、RLAIF（PPO / GRPO / CISPO）、Tool Use、Agentic RL、自適應思考與模型蒸餾等全過程程式碼。
MiniMind 同時拓展了視覺模態模型 MiniMind-V、多模態 Omni 模型 MiniMind-O、擴散語言模型（MiniMind-dLM）、線性模型（MiniMind-Linear），詳見 Discussion。
專案所有核心演算法程式碼均從 0 使用 PyTorch 原生實作，不依賴第三方函式庫提供的高階抽象介面。
這不僅是一個大語言模型全階段開源復現專案，也是一套面向 LLM 入門與實作的教學。
repos.description_src: 🧠 Train a 64M-parameter LLM from scratch in just 2h!

repos.description: PaperOrchestra is a multi-agent framework for automated AI research paper writing.
repos.intro: PaperOrchestra is a multi-agent framework for automated AI research paper writing. It flexibly transforms unconstrained pre-writing materials (ideas and experimental logs) into submission-ready LaTeX manuscripts, including comprehensive literature synthesis and generated visuals, such as plots and conceptual diagrams.
features: Multi-Agent Pipeline : Orchestrates specialized agents (Outline, Literature Review, Section Writing, Content Refinement, Plotting) for end-t…
Comprehensive Literature Synthesis : Automatically searches, prioritizes, and integrates relevant literature into the manuscript.
Visuals Generation : Generates plots and supports the inclusion of conceptual diagrams.
LaTeX Automation : Produces submission-ready LaTeX manuscripts adhering to target conference templates.
repos.description_zh: PaperOrchestra 是一個用於自動化 AI 研究論文寫作的多代理人（multi-agent）框架。
repos.intro_zh: PaperOrchestra 是一個用於自動化 AI 研究論文寫作的多代理人（multi-agent）框架。它能靈活地將不受限的寫作前素材（想法與實驗日誌）轉換為符合投稿要求的 LaTeX 稿件，其中包含全面的文獻綜述以及生成的視覺圖表，例如繪圖（plots）與概念圖（conceptual diagrams）。
features_zh: Multi-Agent Pipeline：協調專業代理人（Outline、Literature Review、Section Writing、Content Refinement、Plotting）以完成端到端的工作流程……
Comprehensive Literature Synthesis：自動搜尋、排序並將相關文獻整合至稿件中。
Visuals Generation：生成繪圖（plots）並支援加入概念圖（conceptual diagrams）。
LaTeX Automation：產出符合目標會議模板、可直接投稿的 LaTeX 稿件。
repos.description_src: PaperOrchestra is a multi-agent framework for automated AI research paper writing.
